Job Title: Sr Software EngineerDuration : ContractLocation : Dearborn, MI Responsibilities:· Seeking an experienced and highly competent Senior Level COBOL Software Engineer/Developer to work on Enhancement, New Development, & Production Support· Projects for a mission critical Legacy Application (Vehicle Invoicing and Drafting, VI&D).· Vehicle Invoicing and Drafting is a Mainframe/COBOL Legacy application; approx. 50+ years old with Online and Batch Programs.· The ideal candidate is independent, very organized, with a keen sense of detail and a natural ability to develop solutions.· Candidate performs superbly under pressure and can balance a number of disparate projects.· The Software Engineer must deliver their project on time and with high quality, according to defined processes. Experience with Agile methodology is a must.· Difficult situations and business partner conversations must be handled tactfully. Both the Business and the Team must like you, trust you, and feel comfortable around you.· VI&D is a mission critical application and core to Ford Motor Company, so some level of stress is expected. If you're up to the challenge, we look forward to speaking with you. Skills Required:· Strict Process Discipline with exposure to Agile Techniques. Logical/Critical Thinker.· COBOL Expert .JCL .VSAM .DB2 .IMS (Strong IMS - Online and Batch) .IBM Utilities (file manager, IEB GENER) .ENDEVOR.· Excellent/OUTSTANDING communication skills (verbal and written) .Superb documentation Skills.
